LanguageData.GameOverDaoAscensionIntro:
``Under the Qing Ming tree, the ethereal fluff rises,
Ascend to immortality, past the ninth gate of heaven.
Qi gathers, transforming the world,
Transcending the mundane, gaining freedom.``

You have cast off the shackles of the mortal world and ascended to immortality. The universe before you, although vast, is no longer distant: a boundless realm awaiting your exploration. Titles like "cultivator" and "immortal" hold little meaning for you now. With Qi flowing like a river, every step you take is a journey beyond the mundane.
LanguageData.GameOverDaoAscensionEnding: After you ascend, your earthly possessions will remain in this realm, while the rest of your consciousness transforms into Qi and traverses towards the void.\n\nYou have not died, you have sublimated into another form: true immortality.
LanguageData.GameOverColonistsAscension: These beings have gone Ascended past mortality:\n\n{0}
